QuestInfo.name: The Return
QuestInfo.0: Looks like Tumbleweed and Cartalion aren't as close as you thought. Hopefully that won't make things harder for you. Ask him about the Interdimensional Portal.
QuestInfo.1: Cartalion seemed confused that you are from Maple World but did not know where the Interdimensional Portal is. He told you about the one inside the Great Temple. Use the dimension gate to go to Maple World.
QuestInfo.2: You used the Interdimensional Portal inside Pantheon's Great Temple and safely returned to Maple World. You wonder what's been going on. Hope for the best.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Automatically start the 2nd Job Advancement once the quest is completed \r\n

0.0: Alright, deep breath... My apologies. That cunning fox... I just get so angry when I think about him. He seemed so clever and friendly... We had so many drinks... And then I woke up alone on a pile of hot wings with a tab bigger than my pension.
0.1: Anyway, you wanted to know about Maple World? Did you not come from there...?
0.2: Ah, you must be one of those sad souls that is terrible with directions. The Interdimensional Portal to Maple World is in the Great Temple on the left. You might want to pin a reminder on your shirt next time, friend.

yes.0: I hope you enjoyed your time in Grandis. And tell Tumbleweed his days are numbered. Take care!

no.0: By all means, enjoy the sights of Pantheon while you're here. The endless siege hasn't done us any favors, but I still think it's a great place to live.

default.0: The Interdimensional Portal to Maple World is in the Great Temple on the left.
